name: a2a-mod
description: A2A protocol client for Claude Code, with a LAN mode (fork of NovusEdge/a2a-mod).

plugins.name: a2a-mod
plugins.description: A2A protocol client for Claude Code: Claude hands tasks to non-Claude worker agents over Agent2Agent and picks up their results. LAN mode: Claude Code sessions on the same network find each other and exchange messages and files.
